biotools.summary: MAPtools is an open-source Python3 application for analyzing genomic data from bulked segregant analysis experiments, including mapping-by-sequencing (MBS) and quantitative trait locus sequencing (QTL-seq) experiments. It provides command-line tools for calculating allele count-based statistics, generating plots, and annotating effects of mutations.
